title: Factorial Lattice-Regularity Bounds for Equilibrium Displacements
exact_target: Can the far-field regularity constants for crystalline-defect equilibria be controlled by a single factorial bound in every derivative order?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30003752 (OWR-15998-002). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Mathematical Methods in Quantum Chemistry (2018), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2018/13, pp. 631--721. Primary report accessed 2026-10-11; relevant PDF pages 13.
Oberwolfach Report 13 (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).
Crystal equilibration (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).

status_qualification: The report already gives bounds with order-dependent constants $C_j$; the target is the stronger common-$C$ factorial estimate. The defect model, stability and meaning of away from the defect must remain the source hypotheses.
